title: physaria pinetorum subsp. iveyana
intro: Physaria pinetorum subsp. iveyana, commonly known as Ivey's bladderpod, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are thought to aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Physaria pinetorum subsp. iveyana include its ability to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which may help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. Bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates and glucosinolates, which have been shown to possess antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
